components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 8px 15px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); border: 1px solid var(--color-btn-primary-bg, #0a0a0a); background: var(--color-btn-primary-bg, #0a0a0a); color: var(--color-btn-primary-text, #ffffff); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-btn-primary-hover, #27272a); border-color: var(--color-btn-primary-hover, #27272a); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #0070f3); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 8px 15px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #e4e4e7); background: var(--color-bg-elevated, #ffffff); color: var(--color-text, #0a0a0a); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 120ms ease, background 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-border-strong, #d4d4d8); background: var(--color-bg-hover, #f4f4f5); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #0070f3); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview: JJ Lab is a technical portfolio and engineering notebook calibrated to the Linear and Vercel craft bar: razor-sharp monochrome contrast, 1px hairline structural grids, tabular monospace telemetry, and zero decorative AI-template gloss.
keyCharacteristics: High-contrast monochrome foregrounds paired with 1px hairline grid dividers.
Single precision blue accent reserved strictly for interactive links, keyboard focus rings, and active verification tokens.
Machined small radii (4px-8px) with tabular numerals on all metrics, dates, and PR identifiers.
Zero gradient text, zero blur/glassmorphism, and zero ungrounded decorative badges.

rules.name: The Single-Accent Discipline Rule
rules.body: precision-cobalt never fills large decorative banners or primary CTA buttons; primary buttons stay solid monochrome so cobalt signals purely clickable proof, links, and focus.

rules.name: The Semantic Dot Rule
rules.body: Status hues appear strictly inside 6px circular StatusDot indicators—never as text colors or badge fills.

rules.name: The Tabular Telemetry Rule
rules.body: Every metric readout, date, PR chip, and footer counter applies tabular-nums so numbers align cleanly across grids and rows.

rules.name: The Hairline Grid Rule
rules.body: Multi-cell metric panels achieve structural crispness by setting gap: 1px against a hairline-border container background rather than drawing floating individual boxes.

dos: Do keep all data claims, PR numbers, and test counts linked to real repositories or MDX evidence.
Do use 1px gap grids (background: var(--color-border)) for multi-cell telemetry and proof matrices.
Do keep tabular-nums enabled on every metric, date, and counter.
Do support both [data-theme='light'] and [data-theme='dark'] via CSS custom properties in src/styles/tokens.css.
donts: Don't add gradient text, neon glows, heavy drop shadows, or backdrop-filter glassmorphism.
Don't place kickers/eyebrows above section headings or decorative bars down the side of cards.
Don't introduce Tailwind CSS or client-side UI frameworks (keep Astro 5 + scoped native CSS).
Don't use status colors (#16a34a, #ca8a04) as full badge backgrounds or body text colors.
